title: Echo Beat 210
description: In a dilapidated vintage cinema, a woman in an orange jumpsuit stands before a large shattered mirror, reaching toward her own reflection which shows a different patterned dress. A translucent ghostly figure of a woman in a flowing gown floats to the right, while film reels, scattered film strips, and a tipped-over film canister litter the dusty floor beneath decaying frescoed ceilings.
prompt: A woman in an orange jumpsuit stands in an abandoned ornate cinema with peeling frescoes on the ceiling, reaching toward a large cracked mirror that reflects her as a woman in a patterned vintage dress. A translucent ghostly woman in a flowing lavender gown floats beside her. Film reels and strips are scattered across the floor next to a tipped film canister. Dramatic spotlight beams cut through the dusty air, cinematic surreal scene, detailed digital painting.
